The Why
"

I can't type as fast as I write.

Given a choice between fighting a small keyboard and just writing it down, the answer is obvious. So people take notes by hand during the walk, then sit down later and type it all again from scratch.

Ian Whitfield, Superintendent, SKYGRiD
The Problem

Manual. Repetitive. Multiplied by every item.

Today's ProjectSight punch flow works - but it's a lot of taps: description, photo, location, due date, responsible company, assignee, save. Then you do it again. And again. 15 to 50+ times, every single walk.

I prefer taking notes by hand on paper during walks and transcribing them at a computer later because typing on a small keyboard is difficult and less efficient.

Ian Whitfield, Superintendent, SKYGRiD

It's not a hard process but tedious and repetitive that you have to do for every single item and it adds up pretty fast.

Brenan Gore, Project Manager, Hensel Phelps

I don't want to do things three or four times over. Anything that would help diminish time-consuming, redoing stuff, because I have to stay focused on the issue.

Brad Patterson, Superintendent, Oelrich Construction

The Solution

Meet AI Punch Walk.

Say it once, on the walk. Let AI do the documentation.

How It Works

One engine, extended.

AI Daily Reports was built with extensibility in mind - one engine designed to be reused, not rebuilt. Punch Walk extends that same engine to create multiple structured items from a single walk, instead of one report from one entry.

Powered by Trimble AI
The Experience

Hit record. Walk. Talk.

Open Punch Items, tap the +, choose Punch Walk. Set up camera and mic, then walk the site talking naturally - describing issues the way you already would out loud.

Items appear instantly on your phone, media attached, before you've even left the floor.

Built Right, From Day One

Observable by design.

Telemetry and observability weren't bolted on after the fact - they were part of the pipeline from Phase 1.

Every stage is traceable
Scoping, lookup, and agent steps each emit a distinct pipeline event, so we always know exactly where a request is and what happened at each step.
Consistent log tagging
All traces from this feature carry a shared prefix for clean filtering - built on the same observability infrastructure as Daily Reports, not rebuilt from scratch.
Fails safely
A degraded AI backend trips the circuit breaker and returns a clear error - never a silent crash or a corrupted stream.
Tested against the real thing
Integration tests run end-to-end against the live LLM - no mocks - including noisy transcripts, to confirm filler chatter never becomes a punch item.
